title: Should Your Business Use Spotify Ads?

facts.fact: The article was published on October 7, 2024.
The article describes Spotify as having millions of listeners tuning in daily.
facts.quote: Spotify has grown into a global audio streaming powerhouse with millions of listeners tuning in daily.

facts.fact: According to the article, Spotify ad formats include short audio clips played between songs, banner ads shown in the app, and interactive video spots.
facts.quote: Whether it’s through short, snappy audio clips that play between songs, visually engaging banners that pop up in the app, or interactive video spots during a music break

facts.fact: The article states that Spotify ad targeting can be based on age, gender, location, interests, and music tastes.
facts.quote: You can target ads based on age, gender, location, interests, and even music tastes.

facts.fact: The article states that users can skip Spotify audio ads after a few seconds.
facts.quote: the ability for users to skip audio ads after a few seconds
